name: Dholavira Tourism Resort (GTDC) Restaurant
signature_dish: Home-style Kutchi thali with less oil
why_it_matters: The Gujarat Tourism (GTDC) resort at Khadir Bet — basic government-run rooms with a small in-house restaurant. The thali is ₹125, home-style, deliberately less oily (a GTDC standard). Wins because Dholavira is genuinely remote: Khadir Island is accessible only by your own transport and the only standalone restaurants are the ones inside the 3-4 resorts. The Harappan UNESCO site is 1km from here.
insider_tip: Lunch (12-2pm) is the only safe window — outside that, the kitchen runs minimal. Pre-book even if you're not staying; walk-in seating is limited. The ₹125 thali is great value but don't expect ambition; it's a sustenance meal in a remote zone.
signature_address: Dholavira Tourism Resort (GTDC), Khadir Bet, Dholavira, Kutch District, Gujarat 370165

name: Evoke Dholavira Resort Restaurant
signature_dish: Resort multi-cuisine dining with desert views
why_it_matters: Evoke Dholavira is the most upmarket resort on Khadir Bet — fine-dining standard food in a region where the GTDC alternative serves a ₹125 thali. Wins for travellers staying overnight at Evoke (rooms ₹6-10K/night) and wanting a 3-course dinner. The Kutchi thali at lunch is the local-flavour option; the multi-cuisine dinner gets the resort-clientele orders.
insider_tip: Stay at Evoke for the dining to make sense — day-visit meals are bookable but the value drops away from package pricing. October-February is the right window; April-September is too hot for the desert open-air dining. Reserve at booking confirmation, not on arrival.
signature_address: Evoke Dholavira, Khadir Bet, Near Harappan Archaeological Site, Dholavira, Kutch District, Gujarat 370165

name: Heritage Resort Dholavira
signature_dish: Authentic Kutchi cuisine in traditional bhungas
why_it_matters: Heritage Resort Dholavira is built in the traditional Kutchi bhunga style — circular mud-walled cottages with conical roofs. The kitchen runs on authentic Kutchi recipes (less oily, more dudhi/lauki-forward than mainland Gujarati). Wins for travellers wanting the Hodka-style experience but on the Dholavira side, where the Rann Utsav infrastructure doesn't reach.
insider_tip: Stay-and-eat is the model — day-visit dining is occasionally available but tight on capacity. Bhunga accommodation is part of the experience; the thali tastes different in the round mud structure than in a conventional dining hall. Book by August for the December-January window.
signature_address: Heritage Resort Dholavira, Khadir Bet, Dholavira, Kutch District, Gujarat 370165
